arxiv-2101-02750.title: Assistive arm and hand manipulation: How does current research intersect with actual healthcare needs?
arxiv-2101-02750.creator: Laura Petrich, Jun Jin, Masood Dehghan, Martin Jagersand
arxiv-2101-02750.description: Abstract Human assistive robotics have the potential to help the elderly and individuals living with disabilities with their Activities of Daily Living (ADL). Robotics researchers present bottom up solutions using various control methods for different types of movements. Health research on the other hand focuses on clinical assessment and rehabilitation leaving arguably important differences between the two domains.

arxiv-2102-03602.title: Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection From Temporal Illumination Cues
arxiv-2102-03602.creator: Frank Julca-Aguilar Jason Taylor Mario Bijelic Fahim Mannan Ethan Tseng Felix Heide
arxiv-2102-03602.description: Abstract Today’s state-of-the-art methods for 3D object detection are based on lidar, stereo, or monocular cameras. Lidar-based methods achieve the best accuracy, but have a large footprint, high cost, and mechanically-limited angular sampling rates, resulting in low spatial resolution at long ranges.

arxiv-2103-07702.title: A sharp convergence theorem for the mean curvature flow in spheres I
arxiv-2103-07702.creator: Dong Pu
arxiv-2103-07702.description: Abstract . In this paper, we prove a sharp convergence theorem for the mean curvature flow of arbitrary codimension in spheres which improves Baker’s convergence theorem. In particular, we obtain a new differentiable sphere theorem for submanifolds in spheres. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 53C44 1.

arxiv-2202-13565.description: Abstract . The rapid growth of electric vehicles (EVs) has promised a next-generation transportation system with reduced carbon emission. The fast development of EVs and charging facilities is driving the evolution of Internet of Vehicles (IoV) to Internet of Electric Vehicles (IoEV).

arxiv-2205-05644.title: Enhancing gravitational wave anisotropies with peaked scalar sources
arxiv-2205-05644.creator: Gianmassimo Tasinato
arxiv-2205-05644.description: Abstract Gravitational wave (GW) backgrounds of cosmological origin are expected to be nearly isotropic, with small anisotropies resembling those of the cosmic microwave background. We analyse the case of a scalar-induced GW background and clarify in the process the relation between two different approaches to calculating GW anisotropies.

arxiv-2304-05121.title: APISens - Sentiment Scoring Tool for APIs with Crowd-Knowledge
arxiv-2304-05121.creator: Kisub Kim, Ferdian Thung, Ting Zhang, Ivana Clairine Irsan, Ratnadira Widyasari, Zhou Yang, David Lo
arxiv-2304-05121.description: Abstract Utilizing pre-existing software artifacts, such as libraries and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), is crucial for software development efficiency. However, the abundance of artifacts that provide similar functionality can lead to confusion among developers, resulting in a challenge for proper selection and implementation.

arxiv-2305-18553.title: Controllable Path of Destruction
arxiv-2305-18553.creator: Matthew Siper, Sam Earle, Zehua Jiang, Ahmed Khalifa, Julian Togelius
arxiv-2305-18553.description: Abstract Path of Destruction (PoD) is a self-supervised method for learning iterative generators. The core idea is to produce a training set by destroying a set of artifacts, and for each destructive step create a training instance based on the corresponding repair action. A generator trained on this dataset can then generate new artifacts by repairing from arbitrary states.

arxiv-2307-03515.title: Using the Nucleolus for Incentive Allocation in Vertical Federated Learning
arxiv-2307-03515.creator: Afsana Khan, Marijn ten Thij, Frank Thuijsman, Anna Wilbik
arxiv-2307-03515.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Afsana Khan, Marijn ten Thij, Frank Thuijsman, Anna Wilbik. Vertical federated learning (VFL) is a promising approach for collaboratively training machine learning models using private data partitioned vertically across different parties. Ideally in a VFL setting, the active party (party possessing features of samples with labels) benefits by improving its machine learning model through collaboration with some passive parties (parties possessing additional features of the same samples without labels) in a privacy-preserving manner. However, motivating passive parties to participate in VFL can be challenging.

arxiv-2309-05061.title: First constraints on compact binary environments from LIGO-Virgo data
arxiv-2309-05061.creator: Giada Caneva Santoro, Soumen Roy, Rodrigo Vicente, Maria Haney, Ornella Juliana Piccinni, Walter Del Pozzo, Mario Martinez
arxiv-2309-05061.description: Abstract The LIGO-Virgo analyses of signals from compact binary mergers observed so far have assumed isolated binary systems in a vacuum, neglecting the potential presence of astrophysical environments. We present here the first investigation of environmental effects on each of the events of GWTC-1 and two low-mass events from GWTC-2. We find no evidence for the presence of environmental effects.

arxiv-2310-13086.title: New proofs to measurable, predictable and optional section theorems Funded by H.F.R.I., 3rd Call for H.F.R.I. Scholarships for PHD Canditates, project i.d. 05724.
arxiv-2310-13086.creator: Stefanos Theodorakopoulos
arxiv-2310-13086.description: Abstract We present new, short and elementary proofs of the famous section theorems that are used in Stochastic Calculus. Predictable section is proved directly while measurable section is a simple corollary. Then, optional (resp. accessible) section follows from an intuitive approximation argument based on the dichotomy of predictable and total inaccessible times.

arxiv-2310-14472.title: The dressing field method for diffeomorphisms: a relational framework
arxiv-2310-14472.creator: J. T. François André
arxiv-2310-14472.description: Abstract The dressing field method is a tool to reduce gauge symmetries. Here we extend it to cover the case of diffeomorphisms. The resulting framework is a systematic scheme to produce Diff ⁡ ( M ) \Diff(M) -invariant objects, which has a natural relational interpretation. Its precise formulation relies on a clear understanding of the bundle geometry of field space.

arxiv-2404-12175.title: Quasiparticle cooling algorithms for quantum many-body state preparation
arxiv-2404-12175.creator: Jerome Lloyd, Alexios Michailidis, Xiao Mi, Vadim Smelyanskiy, Dmitry A. Abanin
arxiv-2404-12175.description: Abstract Probing correlated states of many-body systems is one of the central tasks for quantum simulators and processors. A promising approach to state preparation is to realize desired correlated states as steady states of engineered dissipative evolution. A recent experiment with a Google superconducting quantum processor [X. Mi et al.

arxiv-2405-02108.title: Exploring Weak measurements within the Einstein-Dirac Cosmological framework
arxiv-2405-02108.creator: Williams Dhelonga-Biarufu, Dominique Lambert
arxiv-2405-02108.description: Abstract Our study applies the Two-State Formalism alongside weak measurements within a spatially homogeneous and isotropic cosmological framework, wherein Dirac spinors are intricately coupled to classical gravity. We compute the weak values of the energy-momentum tensors, the Z component of spin, and the pure states.

arxiv-2407-10189.title: Search for Dark Matter Annihilation to gamma-rays from SPT-SZ selected Galaxy Clusters
arxiv-2407-10189.creator: Siddhant Manna, Shantanu Desai
arxiv-2407-10189.description: Abstract We search for dark matter annihilation from galaxy clusters in the energy range from 1-300 GeV using nearly 16 years of Fermi-LAT data. For this purpose, we use 350 galaxy clusters selected from the 2500 deg 2 \rm{deg^{2}} SPT-SZ survey.

arxiv-2412-15535.description: Abstract . arxiv-2507-09700.description: Abstract . 2023 year marks the hundredth birth anniversary of prominent Russian mathematician and thinker Igor Rostislavovich Shafarevich (1923 – 2017). arxiv-2508-03103.creator: Soumik Ghosh
arxiv-2508-03103.description: Abstract . We prove some perversity bounds for the Chern classes of a compactified Jacobian fibration, namely the k k -th Chern class of the compactified Jacobian has perversity ≤ k \leq k . Our results are motivic in nature and we also prove a filtration version of a conjecture raised in [ BMSY24 ] . 0.

arxiv-2509-21663.title: Logic of Hypotheses: from Zero to Full Knowledge in Neurosymbolic Integration
arxiv-2509-21663.creator: Davide Bizzaro, Alessandro Daniele
arxiv-2509-21663.description: Abstract Neurosymbolic integration (NeSy) blends neural-network learning with symbolic reasoning. The field can be split between methods injecting hand-crafted rules into neural models, and methods inducing symbolic rules from data. We introduce Logic of Hypotheses (LoH), a novel language that unifies these strands, enabling the flexible integration of data-driven rule learning with symbolic priors and expert knowledge.

arxiv-2601-08764.title: FusID: Modality-Fused Semantic IDs for Generative Music Recommendation
arxiv-2601-08764.creator: Haven Kim Yupeng Hou Julian McAuley
arxiv-2601-08764.description: Abstract Generative recommendation systems have achieved significant advances by leveraging semantic IDs to represent items. However, existing approaches that tokenize each modality independently face two critical limitations: (1) redundancy across modalities that reduces efficiency, and (2) failure to capture inter-modal interactions that limits item representation.

arxiv-2602-08385.title: Testing Backward-Flatness of Nonlinear Discrete-Time Systems This research was funded in whole, or in part, by the Austrian Science Fund (FWF) P36473. For the purpose of open access, the author has applied a CC BY public copyright license to any Author Accepted Manuscript version arising from this s
arxiv-2602-08385.creator: Johannes Schrotshamer, Bernd Kolar, Markus Schöberl
arxiv-2602-08385.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Johannes Schrotshamer, Bernd Kolar, Markus Schöberl. Despite ongoing research, testing the flatness of discrete-time systems remains a challenging problem. To date, only the property of forward-flatness — a special case of difference-flatness — can be checked in a computationally efficient manner. In this paper, we propose a systematic approach for testing backward-flatness, which is another special case of difference-flatness, and for deriving a corresponding backward-flat output.

arxiv-2602-17064.title: Formalization of Two Fixed-Point Algorithms in Hilbert Spaces
arxiv-2602-17064.creator: Yifan Bai, Yantao Li, Jian Yu, Jingwei Liang
arxiv-2602-17064.description: Abstract Iterative algorithms are fundamental tools for approximating fixed-points of nonexpansive operators in real Hilbert spaces. Among them, Krasnosel’skiĭ–Mann iteration and Halpern iteration are two widely used schemes. In this work, we formalize the convergence of these two fixed-point algorithms in the interactive theorem prover Lean4 based on type dependent theory.

pmc-11600360.creator: Kanya Ahuja, Umer Muhammad, Kaweeta Ahuja, Ramanathapura Haricharan, Pratikkumar Patel

pmc-11636556.creator: Mona Jeffreys, Lis Ellison-Loschmann, Maite Irurzun-Lopez, Jacqueline Cumming, Fiona McKenzie
pmc-11636556.description: BackgroundIn Aotearoa New Zealand, co-payments to see a general practitioner (GP, family doctor) or collect a prescription are payable by virtually all adults.ObjectiveTo examine the extent to which these user co-payments are a barrier to accessing health care, focussing on inequities for indigenous Māori.MethodsPooled data from sequential waves (years) of the New Zealand Health Survey, 2011/12 to 2018/19 were analysed.

pmc-12559382.title: Impact of symptom burden clusters on self-efficacy and quality of life in hemodialysis patients: a multicenter cross-sectional study
pmc-12559382.creator: Alaa S Attoun, Dania Abuhalima, Samah W Al-Jabi, Sa’ed H Zyoud
pmc-12559382.description: Hemodialysis is a therapeutic procedure used to manage and treat acute and chronic kidney failure, which cannot respond to traditional medical therapy. Patients undergoing hemodialysis frequently experience multiple burdensome symptoms that impact their psychological and physical well-being. Understanding how symptom burden influences self-efficacy and quality of life is essential to improve care for this population.

pmc-12637259.title: Childhood obesity management in primary care: Bridging guidelines and practice
pmc-12637259.creator: Venkata Sushma Chamarthi, Jennifer Lynn McCauley, Evan P Nadler, Sarah Ro
pmc-12637259.description: IntroductionChildhood obesity continues to escalate in prevalence and severity, affecting nearly one in five U.S. children. Severe obesity is the fastest-growing subcategory, with disproportionately high rates among adolescents, non-Hispanic Black and Hispanic youth, and those from lower socioeconomic backgrounds. The resulting burden spans the life course, increasing risks for metabolic, cardiovascular, and psychosocial complications.

pmc-12971803.creator: Angelo Brandelli Costa, Silvia Helena Koller, Henrique Caetano Nardi
pmc-12971803.description: This article analyzes personality assessment instruments used in Brazilian psychology in the early 2000s. pmc-13093922.creator: Gyuli Baek, Eunju Lee
pmc-13093922.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study evaluated a virtual reality (VR) simulation program grounded in Kolb’s experiential learning theory to enhance nursing students’ DKA care competencies.MethodsA randomized controlled trial was conducted with 44 nursing students (experimental: n = 22, control: n = 22) recruited via convenience sampling at a university in Korea. pmc-13345797.title: Mapping the knowledge landscape of lymph node metastasis in ovarian cancer: a bibliometric and collaboration network analysis
pmc-13345797.creator: Chunru Chen, Xiaohua Cheng, Yingjie Zhang, Chenyang Cui, Yanan Peng, Juan Wang, Wenting Li, Fuxia Li
pmc-13345797.description: BackgroundLymph node metastasis (LNM) is a critical pathway for the spread of ovarian cancer, significantly influencing staging, treatment decisions, and patient prognosis. This study uses bibliometric methods to analyze global research trends, core themes, and future directions in ovarian cancer LNM.
